entries.rationale: The destructive CLI now rejects path traversal, links and protected Level 0 targets before any side effect; active usage and security documentation must state the boundary.
readerPaths: Script reference -> safe workspace-name contract -> dry-run -> teardown
entries.navigationImpact: Updates the existing teardown man page and threat-model section; no new navigation entry.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Automated temporary-Home probes execute Bash and PowerShell paths for traversal, separators, configured Level 0 sources, workspace and Git-metadata links, backup-link collisions and a legitimate direct child.
entries.risk: Platform path and link semantics can differ; the paired runtime probes and native-host CI must remain green.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Teardown target semantics, supported platforms, link handling or protected Level 0 paths change
